source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Offering fairly little meaningful benefit to stroke survivors or their families compared with other available resources","B":"Taking the place of the professional medical or psychological care the client and family would otherwise still need","C":"Providing peer connection, shared coping strategies, and emotional support from others who have experienced similar challenges","D":"Being relevant mainly to clients with the most severe stroke-related deficits, rather than to survivors more broadly"}}
source_row.rationale: Stroke support groups can provide valuable peer connection, shared coping strategies, and emotional support from others who have experienced similar challenges, a complementary resource alongside professional care, beneficial across a range of stroke severities.
source_row.source_detail: Value of Peer Support Groups After Stroke
source_row.source_name: American Stroke Association — Stroke Support Group Resources
